text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
In(x, y) ::: x is in y.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Donated(x) ::: x was donated.
HasMine(x, y) ::: x has a mine in y.
Premises:
MountainRange(picuris) ∧ In(picuris, newMexico) ∨ In(picuris, texas) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juanDeOnate, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
HasMine(hardingPegmatite, picuris) ∧ Donated(hardingPegmatite) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
¬∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ In(x, texas) ∧ HasMine(y, x) ∧ Donated(y)) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ In(x, newMexico) ∧ Visited(juanDeOnate, x)) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in New Mexico.
